Why Choose Esgard VPN?

Simple & User-Friendly: Designed for all Android devices with an intuitive and clean interface.
Fast & Reliable Servers: Experience seamless, secure browsing through high-speed global servers.
All-Network Compatible: Works smoothly with Hamrah-e Aval, Irancell, Rightel, and Wi-Fi connections.
Optimized for Popular Apps: Perfect for PUBG, Telegram, Instagram, YouTube, and more.

One-Tap Connection: Just install, tap "Connect," and you're ready to go—no configuration needed.

Note:
Esgard VPN uses Android’s VPNService feature to deliver private, secure access to online content—protecting your privacy every step of the way. 

Foreground Service Permission Notice :

Our app uses Foreground Services to ensure key features function seamlessly in the background. This permission allows the app to:

Provide uninterrupted [describe feature, e.g., VPN connection, file upload, etc.] that is essential to the core functionality of the app.

Ensure the feature is initiated and perceivable by the user.

Allow the service to run only for as long as necessary, and it can be stopped by the user at any time.

This permission is required for the app's functionality and is clearly visible to the user. We respect user privacy, and this service will not affect your experience negatively.
